# Getting help

- **Questions about a project:** open an issue on that repo and add the
  `question` label. Where a repo has Discussions turned on, you can ask
  there instead.
- **Bugs and feature requests:** see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Security problems:** don't open a public issue. See
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **Gaze and the rest of Unbound Force:** start at
  [unboundforce.dev](https://unboundforce.dev).
